purpose: Reassess whether the current Newton-native adaptation line has enough faithful source data to build a strict T-Rex bridge after useful Newton-native behavior was demonstrated.

checkpoint_sanity.interpretation: Official T-Rex checkpoint assets can be loaded as reference assets, but this does not make Newton lift-hold data T-Rex-compatible.

newton_native_useful_behavior_gate.interpretation: The learned residual adapter has useful Newton-native stabilization behavior on the current cup benchmark.

required_source_groups.name: bimanual_62d_state_action_action_abs
required_source_groups.evidence: Newton dense strict inventories list observation.state, action, and action_abs as missing.

required_source_groups.name: accepted_synchronized_head_right_left_cameras
required_source_groups.evidence: Newton outputs contain newton.camera.* visual evidence and manual visual inspection, but strict inventories list observation.images.head, observation.images.wrist_right, and observation.images.wrist_left as missing.

required_source_groups.name: calibrated_nonzero_tactile_f6_10x6
required_source_groups.evidence: Newton contact proxy exists, but calibrated nonzero observation.tactile_f6 is missing and must not be generated from contact proxy.

required_source_groups.name: ten_dense_tactile_deformation_streams
required_source_groups.evidence: Strict inventories list observation.tactile_deform.l0-l4 and r0-r4 as missing.

required_source_groups.name: public_compat_slice
required_source_groups.evidence: The public compatibility slice exposes observation.state/action/action_abs/images/tactile_f6 features, but it is not the current Newton lift-hold source and has no tactile_deform streams.

forbidden_routes: rename_newton.camera.* into accepted T-Rex image keys without a faithful contract
claim official T-Rex bridge compatibility from the current Newton cup benchmark
